title: 🐛 Fix `status_code` being ignored for SSE and JSONL streaming endpoints
decision: Modify tests to remove default endpoint tests, use `@pytest.mark.parametrize`, specify `responses` for dependency routes, and test full OpenAPI schema
why: to avoid duplication, be cleaner and closer to real use case, and avoid masking schema issues
quote: testing just specific fields can mask the issue in schama
